processes.title: Processes
processes.subtitle: A process is a multi-step approval: it parks at a user task, waits for a decision, then runs service steps and branches on conditions until it ends. Nothing starts until the definition is published and the process is enabled. Timers on a task mark it overdue and escalate it to someone else.
